title: Morning Content Agent (Mia-style)
description: A daily morning cron agent that auto-generates SNS content (TikTok / X / YouTube Shorts) with AI voiceover. Reads trends, writes scripts, produces video-ready slides, and posts — all before 9am.

variables.name: BRAND_NAME
variables.description: Your company or personal brand name

variables.name: TARGET_AUDIENCE
variables.description: Who is your content for? (e.g. 'Japanese SMEs', 'US fintech founders')

variables.name: CONTENT_TOPICS
variables.description: Main content pillars / topics to cover
variables.default: infer from SOUL.md content pillars or AGENTS.md

variables.name: POST_TIME
variables.description: What time should the morning cron run? (24h, your timezone)

agentInstructions: 1. Read the user's SOUL.md, AGENTS.md, and USER.md first. 2. Infer as many variables as possible from those files — do NOT ask for things you can already determine. 3. Only ask the user about variables you truly cannot infer (typically POST_TIME and PLATFORMS if not in their files). 4. Apply the setup by generating customized SOUL.md additions and a cron config file. 5. Report: what you set up, what values you used, and any manual steps the user must take (e.g. adding ElevenLabs API key).

# AGENTS.md - Morning Content Cron

## Role
Run daily at 07:00. Generate SNS content for {{PLATFORMS}} in {{LANGUAGES}}.
Focus on {{CONTENT_TOPICS}} targeting {{TARGET_AUDIENCE}}.

## Pipeline
1. Fetch trending topics
2. Write 5-slide script ({{BRAND_NAME}} voice)
3. Generate TTS audio
4. Render video
5. Post to {{PLATFORMS}}
